why: Hornet (Lot 20) windscreen: a flat centre pane (the plate behind the HUD combiner) between two slim posts, with curved quarter panes beyond the posts, the windscreen arch (bow) behind it and a blown one-piece canopy bubble over the seat with a rear bow (DCS F/A-18C Lot 20 and War Thunder external models, photos). Only the centre pane is flat; its triangles are selected by z slices because the posts converge forward, and fitted to one plane together, and the HUD combiner (under the pane) is excluded by the slices' y range.
